title: They handled it like pros! #OffBroadway #DannyAndTheDeepBlueSea #Aubr...
transcript: This was a first for me. I just got back from seeing Danny in the Deep Blue Sea, which is a play off Broadway with Aubrey Plaza and Christopher Abbott. And right before the show is about to begin, the director comes up and says, hey, guys, I'm the director. Just wanted to let you know there's been an injury. The show will go on, but just wanted to make you aware. The show begins, and we come to find out that Christopher Abbott has hurt his ankle and tattoos the entire show on crutches. And honestly, props to these two actors and everyone that worked to completely restage the show, because genuinely, I don't think I would have had any idea that something was up had they not told us, because the first thing that you find out about Christopher's character is that he was in a fight the night before the play started. And so it actually kind of worked. There definitely some moments that are a little bit clunky because of the crutches, but there are also some moments that it honestly elevates the material. Like, there is a scene where Christopher's character has to carry a pitcher of beer over to the table where Aubrey is sitting at, and because he's on crutches, the beer is spilling everywhere. It's not very graceful. And it honestly felt like it could have been a planned bit that was always in the show. Like, it was genuinely really funny. So if you saw the show pre crutches, please sound off in the comments because I am so curious about what had to be changed because genuinely I could not tell what had to be restaged and what didn't.
